    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if b[i - 1] != i:
            children[b[i - 1]].append(i)
    
    # Create a list to store the depth of each node
    depth = [0] * (n + 1)

        if b[i - 1] == i:
            root = i

            return [-1]
    
    # Assign weights to the edges
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        weights[p[i]] = depth[p[i + 1]] - depth[p[i]] + 1
